mapper.sql:
select p.page_id as pageId, p.page_code as pageCode, p.page_name as pageName, p.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, p.status, p.is_deleted as isDeleted, p.delete_by as deleteBy, p.delete_time as deleteTime, p.current_revision_id as currentRevisionId, r.version_no as currentVersionNo, p.create_by as createBy, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_by as updateBy, p.update_time as updateTime, p.remark from dashboard_page p left join dashboard_page_folder f on f.folder_id = p.folder_id left join dashboard_page_revision r on r.revision_id = p.current_revision_id
and p.is_deleted = '1' and p.is_deleted = '0'
and (p.page_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.page_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and p.folder_id = #{folderId}
and p.folder_id in #{id}
and 1 = 0
order by p.page_id desc
mapper.select: select p.page_id as pageId, p.page_code as pageCode, p.page_name as pageName, p.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, p.status, p.is_deleted as isDeleted, p.delete_by as deleteBy, p.delete_time as deleteTime, p.current_revision_id as currentRevisionId, r.version_no as currentVersionNo, p.create_by as createBy, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_by as updateBy, p.update_time as updateTime, p.remark from dashboard_page p left join dashboard_page_folder f on f.folder_id = p.folder_id left join dashboard_page_revision r on r.revision_id = p.current_revision_id where p.page_id = #{pageId}

select p.page_id as pageId, p.page_code as pageCode, p.page_name as pageName, p.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, p.status, p.is_deleted as isDeleted, p.delete_by as deleteBy, p.delete_time as deleteTime, p.current_revision_id as currentRevisionId, r.version_no as currentVersionNo, p.create_by as createBy, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_by as updateBy, p.update_time as updateTime, p.remark from dashboard_page p left join dashboard_page_folder f on f.folder_id = p.folder_id left join dashboard_page_revision r on r.revision_id = p.current_revision_id where p.is_deleted = '1'
and (p.page_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.page_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by p.delete_time desc, p.page_id desc

select page_id as pageId, page_code as pageCode, page_name as pageName, status, is_deleted as isDeleted, current_revision_id as currentRevisionId, (select version_no from dashboard_page_revision where revision_id = p.current_revision_id) as currentVersionNo, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_page p where page_code = #{pageCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_page (page_code, page_name, folder_id, status, is_deleted, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{pageCode}, #{pageName}, #{folderId}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update dashboard_page set is_deleted = '1', delete_by = #{deleteBy}, delete_time = now(), status = '1', update_by = #{deleteBy}, update_time = now() where page_id = #{pageId} and is_deleted = '0'
update dashboard_page set is_deleted = '0', delete_by = null, delete_time = null, status = '0', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where page_id = #{pageId} and is_deleted = '1'
mapper.delete: delete from dashboard_page where page_id = #{pageId} and is_deleted = '1'
mapper.select: select folder_id as folderId, folder_code as folderCode, folder_name as folderName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_page_folder where status = '0' order by sort_order asc, folder_id asc

select folder_id as folderId, folder_code as folderCode, folder_name as folderName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_page_folder where folder_id = #{folderId}

select folder_id as folderId, folder_code as folderCode, folder_name as folderName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_page_folder where folder_code = #{folderCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_page_folder (folder_code, folder_name, parent_id, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{folderCode}, #{folderName}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(*) from dashboard_page where folder_id = #{folderId} and is_deleted = '0'
select count(*) from dashboard_page_folder where parent_id = #{folderId} and status = '0'

select revision_id as revisionId, page_id as pageId, version_no as versionNo, status, schema_hash as schemaHash, publish_note as publishNote, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, publish_by as publishBy, publish_time as publishTime from dashboard_page_revision where page_id = #{pageId} order by version_no desc

select revision_id as revisionId, page_id as pageId, version_no as versionNo, status, schema_json as schemaJson, schema_hash as schemaHash, publish_note as publishNote, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, publish_by as publishBy, publish_time as publishTime from dashboard_page_revision where revision_id = #{revisionId}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_page_revision (page_id, version_no, status, schema_json, schema_hash, publish_note, create_by, create_time) values (#{pageId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{schemaJson}, #{schemaHash}, #{publishNote}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update dashboard_page_revision set schema_json = #{schemaJson}, schema_hash = #{schemaHash}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where revision_id = #{revisionId} and status = 'DRAFT'
update dashboard_page set current_revision_id = #{revisionId}, update_time = now() where page_id = #{pageId}
mapper.select: order by dataset_id desc

select dataset_id as datasetId, dataset_code as datasetCode, dataset_name as datasetName, group_code as groupCode, data_type as dataType, config_json as configJson, field_schema_json as fieldSchemaJson, param_schema_json as paramSchemaJson, status, timeout_seconds as timeoutSeconds, refresh_seconds as refreshSeconds, last_test_at as lastTestAt, last_test_status as lastTestStatus, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_dataset where dataset_id = #{datasetId}

select dataset_id as datasetId, dataset_code as datasetCode, dataset_name as datasetName, group_code as groupCode, data_type as dataType, config_json as configJson, field_schema_json as fieldSchemaJson, param_schema_json as paramSchemaJson, status, timeout_seconds as timeoutSeconds, refresh_seconds as refreshSeconds, last_test_at as lastTestAt, last_test_status as lastTestStatus, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_dataset where dataset_code = #{datasetCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_dataset (dataset_code, dataset_name, group_code, data_type, config_json, field_schema_json, param_schema_json, status, timeout_seconds, refresh_seconds, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{datasetCode}, #{datasetName}, #{groupCode}, #{dataType}, #{configJson}, #{fieldSchemaJson}, #{paramSchemaJson}, #{status}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{refreshSeconds}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update dashboard_dataset set last_test_status = #{status}, last_test_at = now() where dataset_id = #{datasetId}
update dashboard_dataset set field_schema_json = #{fieldSchemaJson}, update_time = now() where dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.select: select group_id as groupId, group_code as groupCode, group_name as groupName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_dataset_group order by sort_order asc, group_id asc

select group_id as groupId, group_code as groupCode, group_name as groupName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_dataset_group where group_id = #{groupId}

select group_id as groupId, group_code as groupCode, group_name as groupName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_dataset_group where group_code = #{groupCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_dataset_group (group_code, group_name, parent_id, sort_order, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{groupCode}, #{groupName}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(*) from dashboard_dataset where group_code = #{groupCode}
select count(*) from dashboard_dataset_group where parent_id = #{groupId}

select folder_id as folderId, folder_code as folderCode, folder_name as folderName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_resource_folder where status = '0' order by sort_order asc, folder_id asc

select folder_id as folderId, folder_code as folderCode, folder_name as folderName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_resource_folder where folder_id = #{folderId}

select folder_id as folderId, folder_code as folderCode, folder_name as folderName, parent_id as parentId, sort_order as sortOrder, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_resource_folder where folder_code = #{folderCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_resource_folder (folder_code, folder_name, parent_id, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{folderCode}, #{folderName}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, '0', #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(*) from dashboard_asset where folder_id = #{folderId}
select count(*) from dashboard_map_resource where folder_id = #{folderId}
select count(*) from dashboard_resource_folder where parent_id = #{folderId} and status = '0'

select share_id as shareId, page_id as pageId, revision_id as revisionId, version_mode as versionMode, share_token as token, expires_at as expiresAt, status, created_by as createdBy, created_at as createdAt, last_access_at as lastAccessAt from dashboard_share where page_id = #{pageId} order by share_id desc

select share_id as shareId, page_id as pageId, revision_id as revisionId, is_entry as isEntry, sort_order as sortOrder from dashboard_share_page where share_id = #{shareId} order by is_entry desc, sort_order asc, page_id asc

select sp.share_id as shareId, sp.page_id as pageId, p.page_code as pageCode, p.page_name as pageName, p.status as pageStatus, p.is_deleted as pageDeleted, sp.revision_id as revisionId, r.version_no as versionNo, r.status as revisionStatus, sp.is_entry as isEntry, sp.sort_order as sortOrder, sp.created_at as createdAt from dashboard_share_page sp join dashboard_page p on p.page_id = sp.page_id join dashboard_page_revision r on r.revision_id = sp.revision_id where sp.share_id = #{shareId} order by sp.is_entry desc, sp.sort_order asc, sp.page_id asc

select sp.share_id as shareId, sp.page_id as pageId, p.page_code as pageCode, p.page_name as pageName, p.status as pageStatus, p.is_deleted as pageDeleted, sp.revision_id as revisionId, r.version_no as versionNo, r.status as revisionStatus, sp.is_entry as isEntry, sp.sort_order as sortOrder from dashboard_share_page sp join dashboard_page p on p.page_id = sp.page_id left join dashboard_page_revision r on r.revision_id = sp.revision_id where sp.share_id = #{shareId} and p.page_code = #{pageCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_share_page (share_id, page_id, revision_id, is_entry, sort_order, created_at) values (#{shareId}, #{pageId}, #{revisionId}, #{isEntry}, #{sortOrder}, now())
mapper.select: select s.share_id as shareId, s.page_id as pageId, s.revision_id as revisionId, p.page_code as pageCode, s.token_hash as tokenHash, s.expires_at as expiresAt, s.status, s.version_mode as versionMode, s.created_by as createdBy, s.created_at as createdAt, s.last_access_at as lastAccessAt from dashboard_share s left join dashboard_page p on p.page_id = s.page_id where s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_share (page_id, revision_id, token_hash, share_token, expires_at, status, version_mode, created_by, created_at) values (#{pageId}, #{revisionId}, #{tokenHash}, #{token}, #{expiresAt}, #{status}, #{versionMode}, #{createdBy}, now())
mapper.select: select share_id as shareId, page_id as pageId, revision_id as revisionId, expires_at as expiresAt, status, version_mode as versionMode from dashboard_share where share_id = #{shareId} and page_id = #{pageId} for update
select revision_id as revisionId, page_id as pageId, version_no as versionNo, status from dashboard_page_revision where revision_id = #{revisionId}

select revision_id as revisionId, page_id as pageId, version_no as versionNo, status from dashboard_page_revision where page_id = #{pageId} and status = 'PUBLISHED' order by case when revision_id = #{currentRevisionId} then 0 else 1 end, version_no desc, revision_id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update dashboard_share set version_mode = #{versionMode}, revision_id = #{revisionId} where share_id = #{shareId} and page_id = #{pageId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update dashboard_share_page set revision_id = #{revisionId} where share_id = #{shareId} and page_id = #{pageId}
update dashboard_share set last_access_at = now() where share_id = #{shareId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
update dashboard_share set status = 'REVOKED' where share_id = #{shareId} and page_id = #{pageId} and status = 'ACTIVE'

where.if: and upper(case when json_valid(s.config_json) then coalesce(json_unquote(json_extract(s.config_json, '$.environment')), '') else '' end) = upper(#{environment})

mapper.select: select count(*) from dashboard_data_source s

select s.data_source_id as dataSourceId, s.source_code as sourceCode, s.source_name as sourceName, s.source_type as sourceType, s.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, s.config_json as configJson, s.status, s.remark from dashboard_data_source s left join dashboard_data_folder f on f.folder_id = s.folder_id and f.scope = 'source'
order by s.data_source_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select data_source_id as dataSourceId, source_code as sourceCode, source_name as sourceName, source_type as sourceType, folder_id as folderId, (select f.folder_name from dashboard_data_folder f where f.folder_id = s.folder_id and f.scope = 'source') as folderName, config_json as configJson, secret_ciphertext as secretCiphertext, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_data_source s order by data_source_id desc

select data_source_id as dataSourceId, source_code as sourceCode, source_name as sourceName, source_type as sourceType, folder_id as folderId, (select f.folder_name from dashboard_data_folder f where f.folder_id = s.folder_id and f.scope = 'source') as folderName, config_json as configJson, secret_ciphertext as secretCiphertext, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_data_source s where data_source_id = #{dataSourceId}

select data_source_id as dataSourceId, source_code as sourceCode, source_name as sourceName, source_type as sourceType, folder_id as folderId, (select f.folder_name from dashboard_data_folder f where f.folder_id = s.folder_id and f.scope = 'source') as folderName, config_json as configJson, secret_ciphertext as secretCiphertext, status, create_by as createBy, create_time as createTime, update_by as updateBy, update_time as updateTime, remark from dashboard_data_source s where source_code = #{sourceCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_data_source (source_code, source_name, source_type, folder_id, config_json, secret_ciphertext, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{sourceCode}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceType}, #{folderId}, #{configJson}, #{secretCiphertext}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(*) from dashboard_dataset where config_json like concat('%', #{sourceCode}, '%')

select a.asset_id as assetId, a.asset_code as assetCode, a.asset_name as assetName, a.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, a.asset_type as assetType, a.category, a.resource_path as resourcePath, a.mime_type as mimeType, a.file_size as fileSize, a.status, a.create_by as createBy, a.create_time as createTime, a.update_by as updateBy, a.update_time as updateTime, a.remark from dashboard_asset a left join dashboard_resource_folder f on f.folder_id = a.folder_id where a.asset_id = #{assetId}

select a.asset_id as assetId, a.asset_code as assetCode, a.asset_name as assetName, a.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, a.asset_type as assetType, a.category, a.resource_path as resourcePath, a.mime_type as mimeType, a.file_size as fileSize, a.status, a.create_by as createBy, a.create_time as createTime, a.update_by as updateBy, a.update_time as updateTime, a.remark from dashboard_asset a left join dashboard_resource_folder f on f.folder_id = a.folder_id where a.asset_code = #{assetCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_asset (asset_code, asset_name, folder_id, asset_type, category, resource_path, mime_type, file_size, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{folderId}, #{assetType}, #{category}, #{resourcePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select m.map_id as mapId, m.map_code as mapCode, m.map_name as mapName, m.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, m.geojson_json as geojsonJson, m.status, m.create_by as createBy, m.create_time as createTime, m.update_by as updateBy, m.update_time as updateTime, m.remark from dashboard_map_resource m left join dashboard_resource_folder f on f.folder_id = m.folder_id where m.map_id = #{mapId}

select m.map_id as mapId, m.map_code as mapCode, m.map_name as mapName, m.folder_id as folderId, f.folder_name as folderName, m.geojson_json as geojsonJson, m.status, m.create_by as createBy, m.create_time as createTime, m.update_by as updateBy, m.update_time as updateTime, m.remark from dashboard_map_resource m left join dashboard_resource_folder f on f.folder_id = m.folder_id where m.map_code = #{mapCode}
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_map_resource (map_code, map_name, folder_id, geojson_json, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{mapCode}, #{mapName}, #{folderId}, #{geojsonJson}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
